sections.title: Tree and leaves
sections.text: Large-leaved lime is a deciduous European tree, reaching about 35 m. Its heart-shaped, sharply toothed leaves are generally 6–12 cm long and hairy beneath.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Fragrant flowers, usually 2–6 together, hang from a long pale-green bract; the fruit is a strongly ribbed nut containing 1–3 seeds. Young leaves are eaten as salad and flowers are traditionally infused. The plate’s large leaf and bract-borne cluster fit this species.
